question: The sum of the digits of the smallest number which, when divided by 18, 21, 25 and 39 leaves a remainder of 3 in each case is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The smallest required number N = LCM(18, 21, 25, 39) + 3

LCM(18, 21, 25, 39) = 2 × 3² × 5² × 7 × 13 = 40950

N = 40950 + 3 = 40953

Sum of digits of N = 4 + 0 + 9 + 5 + 3 = 21

**∴ The correct answer is 21.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Divisors = 18, 21, 25, and 39

Remainder in each case = 3

**Concept Used:**

The smallest number which, when divided by a, b, c leaves a remainder r in each case is given by the formula: LCM(a, b, c) + r.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Prime factorization of 18 = 2 × 3²

⇒ Prime factorization of 21 = 3 × 7

⇒ Prime factorization of 25 = 5²

⇒ Prime factorization of 39 = 3 × 13

⇒ LCM = Highest powers of all prime factors = 2 × 3² × 5² × 7 × 13

⇒ LCM = 2 × 9 × 25 × 7 × 13

⇒ LCM = 50 × 9 × 91

⇒ LCM = 450 × 91 = 40950

⇒ Required number = 40950 + 3 = 40953

⇒ Sum of digits of the number = 4 + 0 + 9 + 5 + 3 = 21

**∴ The correct answer is 21.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

LCM and Remainder Rule 1

The smallest number leaving a remainder 'r' when divided by a, b, c is calculated as LCM(a, b, c) + r.

LCM and Remainder Rule 2

The smallest number leaving remainders x, y, z when divided by a, b, c respectively is LCM(a, b, c) − K, where K = (a − x) = (b − y) = (c − z).

HCF and Remainder Rule

The largest number dividing a, b, c leaving a remainder 'r' in each case is calculated as HCF(a−r, b−r, c−r).

Divisibility by 9

A number is divisible by 9 if the sum of its digits is a multiple of 9. The remainder when any number is divided by 9 is exactly equal to the remainder when its sum of digits is divided by 9.
